concerns.text: Success criteria SC-002 (‘reduction in dynamic execution cycles’) is not backed by any implementing task. Add a task (e.g., T022) that computes the percentage of tasks skipped after modeling and records it (e.g., in `data/logs/reduction_metric.json`).

Success criteria SC-004 (‘computational feasibility (runtime and memory usage) ≤6h, ~7 GB RAM’) lacks a concrete task to measure and validate pipeline runtime and memory consumption. Add a task (e.g., T023) that instruments the end‑to‑end pipeline, captures total wall‑clock time and peak RAM, and asserts they are within the GitHub Actions limits.

Verification test `tests/integration/test_project_structure.py` expects each top‑level folder to contain at least one file (`.gitkeep` or `structure_tree.txt`). T001 only creates the directories and `structure_tree.txt` but does not create a `.gitkeep` in each folder, so the test may fail. Update T001 to also create an empty `.gitkeep` in every top‑level folder or adjust the verification.
